episodes.title: Pilot
episodes.summary: Desperate to support his family, Gray returns to his criminal roots.

episodes.title: Blood in the Water
episodes.summary: Gray and Colin clash over a big cleanup; Gray dodges his family's growing suspicion; the Tongais pursue new business.

episodes.title: Sanctuary
episodes.summary: Cornered, Gray's allegiance to Horse is put to the ultimate test. The Parish and Tongai families search for their missing loved ones. The Tongais gather intel on their adversary.

episodes.title: Impimpi
episodes.summary: When Anton, an old colleague, learns Gray is working with the Tongais, he forces Gray to choose: his family or Horse; Rose and Makayla work together to survive; Horse searches for a traitor.

episodes.title: Kumba
episodes.summary: Gray and his family face a terrible new normal and reckon with past trauma. Horse singles out the enemy within while expanding his business. He makes Gray an offer he can't refuse.

episodes.title: A Good Man
episodes.summary: Gray discovers unlikely allies as he risks it all for revenge; the Tongais face an unforeseen snag.
